Earlier scenes:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。孟子想，难怪我们常常搬家，原来我妈妈很忙。可是常常搬家害得孟子很难找到朋友。每次搬家孟子也觉得新的地方不是太热就是太冷，不是太大就是太小。在哪的地方，他都不高兴。孟子想帮助妈妈祭拜，可是他六岁，所以不能祭拜。

This scene:
四年后，孟子开始帮妈妈祭拜。他画画很厉害，他越来越喜欢祭拜，所以他祭拜不是想帮妈妈工作，而是他很喜欢画画。孟子成为很著名的古代画家。今天很多中国人很喜欢孟子。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他画画很厉害，他越来越喜欢祭拜：delete the second他，redundant; no logic relationship, add也before越来越
- 孟子成为很著名的古代画家：wrong information, 哲学家

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 成为：成为了，Use 了 after 成为 to mark the completed change of state: Mengzi became a well-known painter.
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他越来越喜欢祭拜，所以他祭拜不是想帮妈妈工作，而是他很喜欢画画：越来越喜欢祭拜，所以祭拜不是想帮妈妈工作，而是很喜欢画画，Use zero form for the same subject in nearby clauses within one sentence instead of repeatedly using the pronoun.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子：他，Use a pronoun when the same character was named in the immediately previous sentence and no other character competes as the referent.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子：他，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character; the previous sentence already identifies Mengzi clearly.

items.reason: 成为 describes a completed change in this past narrative, so 成为了 correctly marks completion.
Removing repeated pronouns correctly uses zero reference, but the corrected text still retains an unsuitable 所以 relationship and lacks the needed 也.
Mengzi has just been established as the same referent, so 他 is required by the stated close-reference rule.
The immediately preceding context identifies Mengzi, so replacing this close repeated name with 他 follows the reference rule.
